message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and I found myself surprisingly calm. I had my trusty flashlight ready and even remembered to charge my power bank ahead of time. As I sat there with my kids, we played games and shared stories by lantern light instead of rushing to find candles. It felt good to finally be the prepared one for a change! Have you ever had a moment where you felt prepared? What’s your go-to tip for when the lights go out? 💡
